title: Noha tha kulsoom ka
body:
noha tha kulsoom ka haye qayamat hui
bhai ko zibha kiya haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon hoshiyar ho bacho ko godhi may lo
hilti hai arze bala haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaat liya sheh ka sar aate hai aada idhar
kaun inhe rokega haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kare bekas behan hota hai pamaal tan
baade khaza ye jafa haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthne laga hai dhuan qaimon se jaaye kahan
aada ne cheeni rida haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon se bahar chalo jaan ki hifazat karo
sholon ne halqa kiya haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima e sajjad bhi zad pa hai ab aag ki
wo to hai ghash may pada haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
noha anees e hazeen lik gaye shaukath makeen
jisne jahan bhi suna haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
author: Shaukath
